name: SikaPlast-82 SCM Impact
paste:
SIKAPLAST®-82 SCM IMPACT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact, June 2025, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikaplast-82-scmimpact.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact is an advanced mid-range water reducer,based on an engineered blend of selected polymers, specifically designed for high slag or and fly ash content concrete mixtures. SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact delivers soft concrete and long slump life with high cement replacement even at extremely low water/binder ratios.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - ▪ Reduced carbon footprint concrete
    - ▪ Post-tensioned concrete with significant cement replacement
    - ▪ Suspended slab concrete
    - ▪ Superworkable and self-compacting concrete
    - ▪ Long haul sites
    - ▪ Concrete with manufactured sand

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Advanced mid-range water reducing admixture of high-volume supplementary cementious materials concrete
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Sustainability. Product characteristics and benefits: SikaPlast®-82 SCM (Supplementary Cementitious Materials) Impact is a new advanced mid-range water reducer, based on an engineered blend of selected polymers, specifically designed for high slag and/or fly ash concrete mixtures.
2.3 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Sika customers benefit from.
    - Increased water cut and improved slump retention when used as a midrange water reducer in high supplementary cementitious materials mixes.
    - Enhanced rheology in high supplementary cementitious materials and low water to binder ratio mixes, addressing pumpability challenges and lowering down the concrete carbon footprint due to a higher cement replacement rate.
2.4 Certificates and test reports. SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact Provisional Patent Pending. SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact complies with AS1478 standard (MWR type)
2.5 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1478: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.6 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact delivers:
    - ▪ soft, workable and pumpable concrete at low water/binder ratios
    - ▪ enhanced slump life which protects the concrete quality in case of long transport time
    - ▪ early strength without activators
    - ▪ easy concrete pumpability
    - ▪ fast wetting time
2.7 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear liquid
    - Density: 1.05 kg/l
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC
    - Shelf life: 12 months from production date if stored as directed
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5° and 35 °C, protected from direct sunlight and frost.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2025, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact is compatible with all Sika concrete admixtures with the exception of Sikament® NN.
4.3 Recommended dosage. Dosage rates will vary according to materials used, ambient conditions and the requirements of a specific project. Sika recommends dosage at 400–1000 ml/100 kg of total cementitious for general concrete applications. Dosage rates outside the recommended range may be used where specialized materials such as microsilica are specified, extreme ambient conditions are encountered or unusual project conditions require special consideration. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials. Please contact your Sika representative for more information and assistance.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2025, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact, June 2025, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/sikaplast-82-scmimpact.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaPlast 82 SCM Impact, version 25/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/m/SikaPlast%C2%AE-82%20SCM%20Impact%20GHS7.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact EPD, version 08/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/h/sikaplast-82-scmimpactepd.pdf
    - Brochure: SikaPlast®-82 SCM Impact Water Reducer for SCM Concrete, version 26/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/SikaPlast%2082%20SCM%20WEB%20BROCHURE.pdf
    - Document: Sustainability Fact Sheet SikaPlast-82 SCM Impact, version 26/09/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/Sustainability%20Fact%20Sheet%20SikaPlast-82%20SCM%20Impact.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
